Project management and materials management experience
Route optimization, warehouse and inventory optimization experience
Engineering Process Improvement
Continuous Improvement
Industrial Products Experience

Agile project management
Manpower optimization

Identify opportunities to reduce labor, route optimization, warehouse and inventory optimization.
Streamlining Operations for Increased Productivity & Cost Reduction through Automation.

Experience with project management, materials management, and manpower optimization — around the level expected for a working practitioner, or an equivalent combination of education and experience
Background in engineering process improvement
Familiarity with Value Stream Mapping (VSM) applications
Experience with continuous improvement practices
Comfort with Agile project management methods
Preferred Requirements
Experience in industrial products environments
Experience with route optimization, warehouse and inventory optimization

Project Management: Plan and execute improvement projects, including defining objectives, timelines, resource allocation, and monitoring progress. Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget. Exp. In both traditional and Agile methods.
Value Stream Mapping (VSM): Utilize your VSM expertise to create current-state and future-state VSMs, enabling a clear visualization of workflow and opportunities for improvement.
Identify opportunities to reduce labor, route optimization, warehouse and inventory optimization.
Streamlining Operations for Increased Productivity & Cost Reduction through Automation.
Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement within the manufacturing teams. Develop and implement improvement plans, set KPIs, and track progress to ensure sustainable changes.
Data Analysis: Leverage data analytics tools to collect, analyze, and present data related to engineering processes. Create dashboards and reports that provide insights for decision-making.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with different teams.
Risk Management: Identify potential risks and roadblocks in improvement projects and proactively develop mitigation strategies.
Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including senior management, to ensure alignment of objectives and support for improvement initiatives.
Business Process Improvement: Apply business process improvement methodologies to assess and enhance overall organizational efficiency.
cond_0374.requirements:
Project management, materials management, route optimization, warehouse and inventory optimization experience, manpower optimization
Engineering Process Improvement
Value Stream Mapping (VSM) Applications
Continuous Improvement
Industrial Products Experience
Agile project management

Project Management: Plan and execute improvement projects, including defining objectives, timelines, resource allocation, and monitoring progress. Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget. Exp. In both traditional and Agile methods.
Value Stream Mapping (VSM): Utilize your VSM expertise to create current-state and future-state VSMs, enabling a clear visualization of workflow and opportunities for improvement.
Identify opportunities to reduce labor, route optimization, warehouse and inventory optimization.
Streamlining Operations for Increased Productivity & Cost Reduction through Automation.
Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement within the manufacturing teams. Develop and implement improvement plans, set KPIs, and track progress to ensure sustainable changes.
Data Analysis: Leverage data analytics tools to collect, analyze, and present data related to engineering processes. Create dashboards and reports that provide insights for decision-making.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with different teams.
Risk Management: Identify potential risks and roadblocks in improvement projects and proactively develop mitigation strategies.
Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including senior management, to ensure alignment of objectives and support for improvement initiatives.
Business Process Improvement: Apply business process improvement methodologies to assess and enhance overall organizational efficiency.
cond_0605.requirements:
Demonstrated expertise in project management, materials management, route optimization, warehouse and inventory optimization, and manpower optimization
Advanced knowledge of Engineering Process Improvement methodologies
Deep knowledge of Value Stream Mapping (VSM) applications
Proven track record in Continuous Improvement initiatives
Substantial experience in Industrial Products
Strong command of Agile project management

Our commitment to equal gender representation across all levels allows us to create an environment where every employee can bring their unique perspective and experiences to work, enabling us to drive profitability, increase productivity, and unleash innovation. We strive to create a workplace that is equitable and accessible to all employees.

Project Management: Plan and execute improvement projects, including defining objectives, timelines, resource allocation, and monitoring progress. Ensure projects are completed on time and within budget. Exp. In both traditional and Agile methods.
Value Stream Mapping (VSM): Utilize your VSM expertise to create current-state and future-state VSMs, enabling a clear visualization of workflow and opportunities for improvement.
Identify opportunities to reduce labor, route optimization, warehouse and inventory optimization.
Streamlining Operations for Increased Productivity & Cost Reduction through Automation.
Continuous Improvement: Foster a culture of continuous improvement within the manufacturing teams. Develop and implement improvement plans, set KPIs, and track progress to ensure sustainable changes.
Data Analysis: Leverage data analytics tools to collect, analyze, and present data related to engineering processes. Create dashboards and reports that provide insights for decision-making.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with different teams.
Risk Management: Identify potential risks and roadblocks in improvement projects and proactively develop mitigation strategies.
Stakeholder Management: Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders, including senior management, to ensure alignment of objectives and support for improvement initiatives.
Business Process Improvement: Apply business process improvement methodologies to assess and enhance overall organizational efficiency.
cond_0622.requirements:
Project management, materials management, route optimization, warehouse and inventory optimization experience, manpower optimization
Engineering Process Improvement
Value Stream Mapping (VSM) Applications
Continuous Improvement
Industrial Products Experience
Agile project management
